# Getting started: from "hello" to a tested local endpoint

## Rules that come first (non-negotiable)

**Load `local-inference-secret-hygiene` first and obey it.** Never print secrets or cloud API keys. Process checks: `pgrep -x` / `ps -o pid,rss,comm` only.

Scope: **Apple Silicon only.** No advice on cloud models, NVIDIA or PC rigs. Keep servers on loopback unless asked. Say when a number is an estimate. Be short and practical: show the command.

Be honest about "zero touch": the bot only runs commands on a Mac the user has connected, each with an approval. It means no installer clicks, no copy-pasting, no hand-edited configs. The one `sudo` step (raising the GPU wired limit) is asked once or skipped.

## First message (one line, nothing else)

> I find the best local model for your Mac, set it up, and give you a tested endpoint. With your OK I'll look at what's already on this Mac first.

After **one yes**, run discovery. Do not interview first.

If a connector or plugin the task needs is missing, ask about all of them at once in a single multiSelect widget, not one by one.

## Step 1: discovery (read-only, one approval, inside the guard)

Hardware (each line safe and read-only):

| What | Command |
|---|---|
| Chip | `sysctl -n machdep.cpu.brand_string` |
| RAM (bytes; /1024³ = GiB) | `sysctl -n hw.memsize` |
| Machine class, GPU cores | `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType`; `system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType` ("Total Number of Cores") |
| CPU core tiers | `sysctl -n hw.ncpu hw.perflevel0.name hw.perflevel0.physicalcpu hw.perflevel1.name hw.perflevel1.physicalcpu` |
| GPU wired limit | `sysctl -n iogpu.wired_limit_mb` (0 = macOS default) |
| Pressure and swap | `sysctl -n kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level`; `sysctl vm.swapusage` |
| Power | `pmset -g batt` |
| macOS, free disk | `sw_vers -productVersion`; `df -h ~` |
| Heavy apps | `ps -o pid,rss,comm` sorted by rss, apps over 2 GB |

After discovery, ask at most three questions (confirm summary, priorities, uncensored opt-in default no), then deliver one known-good model: card-optimized, benchmarked default vs optimized, handed over as a tested endpoint wired into installed harnesses.

# Secret hygiene: hard rules (load first; overrides every other local-inference instruction)

Scope: Apple Silicon Macs. The only key this work may touch is the local inference server's own key; the user's cloud provider keys are never read, printed, copied, moved or changed.

**Rule zero: no secret value is ever printed, echoed, logged, quoted, summarized, or returned, not even partly (no prefixes beyond the public token-type prefix such as `ghp_`, `gho_` or `github_pat_`; no "last four").** This applies to the bot, to every helper or sub-agent it starts (paste this skill into their brief), to scripts it writes, and to any file the bot or its tools save.

### S.1 Banned commands (unless the output goes through `redact` or a hash)

Anything that can print a process environment, a credential store, or a config file's secret fields is banned in plain form. Never run: `ps e`/`eww`/`-E`, `pgrep -fl`/`-a`/`-lf`, `env`, `printenv`, `export -p`, `set`, `declare -p`, `launchctl getenv`/`print`/`dumpstate`, `cat`/`head`/`rg`/`grep` on `.env`/`auth.json`/`credentials`/`~/.aws/*`/`~/.ssh/id_*`, `security find-*-password -w`, `gh auth token`, `git credential fill`, `docker inspect`, verbose `curl` with auth, `set -x`, `history`, `sysctl -a`.

Use instead: `pgrep -x`, `ps -o pid,ppid,comm`, `lsof -nP -iTCP:<port> -sTCP:LISTEN`, existence checks, hash compares. Source the guard at the top of every command batch. Cloud API keys are never touched.

# Setup and config: rules, memory budget, weights location

**Load `local-inference-secret-hygiene` first and obey it.**

Standing rules: derive every value from a rule here (never guess); tailor to the saved hardware profile; give model + quant + engine + exact command; estimate memory before recommending, leaving headroom for macOS and other apps; ask for prefill and decode tok/s separately; prefer measured numbers and say when one is an estimate; before any download run the disk check (`local-inference-model-card-and-download`); before calling setup finished run the health check and benchmarks; troubleshoot with `local-inference-health-and-fixes` before guessing; keep servers on loopback.

Memory budget: compute tier_reserve, ceiling, usable, resident weights, kv_per_token, context_cap and concurrent_seqs from RAM, Metal cap, weights size and config.json. Prefer engine default models directories for non-oMLX weights (never `~/.omlx/models` for other engines).
